addr: 358, 25th B Main Rd, 2nd Sector, Parangi Palaya, Sector 2, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Visited Shelby Coffee recently, and it was a great experience. The coffee was rich, fresh, and perfectly brewed. What impressed me most was the quality they offer at such a reasonable price. the staff are friendly, and the service is quick. …

The coffee was good and well made, no complaints there. However, the bun maska was just average and didn’t really live up to the hype. Overall, the place feels a bit overrated, but it’s still a decent spot if you’re mainly going for coffee.

Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)
